items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: we started from a band with, uh, Oliver Beathen... it was about, uh, 10 or 15 piece band

ctx.x: Who else worked for you in this trio you had there?

Well, this trio started, we started from a band with, uh, Oliver Beathen, I forget, he had a, some book ahead of gave him a contract to go on the road, and we used to hush around at, uh, the local in Chicago, and it was about, uh, 10 or 15 piece band, but when they, and, uh, the bass player and the violin player, they were in the band, so we had got a couple little jobs, just the three of us, and that's where we decided that we should organize the trio. So when the band got ready to go away, well, we didn't go…
What was the band calling them?
